The *Kāḷudāyittheragāthā* (Thag 10.1) is a poem in the *Theragāthā* collection of the Pali Canon, located in the *Dasakanipāta* (Book of Tens) [Catalog; Sujato 2011]. SuttaCentral records ten translations across nine modern languages, including an English translation by Bhikkhu Sujato [SuttaCentral]. Its commentary in the *Theragāthā-aṭṭhakathā* (*Kāḷudāyittheragāthāvaṇṇanā*) is cited in secondary literature regarding the gender of the Buddha's mother upon her rebirth in heaven [Sujato 2011].

SuttaCentral identifies a passage-level parallel to this text in the *Udayasutta* (SN 7.12) of the *Saṃyutta Nikāya* [SuttaCentral]. In agreement with this identification, text-reuse analysis by DharmaNexus detects strong alignment with the *Brāhmaṇa Saṃyutta* (SN 7, specifically matching verses 5.1–6.4 with SN 7.12) [DharmaNexus]. DharmaNexus also demonstrates extensive Pali-internal reuse in the *Apadāna-aṭṭhakathā*, the *Theragāthā-aṭṭhakathā*, and the *Buddhavaṃsa-aṭṭhakathā* [DharmaNexus]. Across languages, DharmaNexus automatically aligns the text with 32 matches in the Sanskrit *Mahāvastu-avadāna* (reaching a plausibility score of 95) and five matches in the Chinese *Saṃyuktāgama* (T 99) [DharmaNexus].
